title: Fix custom Cargo library discovery and scoped npm generation for SpecSync 6.1.1
description: Fix custom Cargo library discovery and scoped npm generation for SpecSync 6.1.1
acceptance_criteria: Custom Cargo library target paths bind to the package module in default, JSON and named generation; scoped npm package names generate a truthful spec and cannot silently return success with no output; regression tests preserve existing owners and confinement; prepare version 6.1.1 and qualify the same immutable candidate on Ubuntu and macOS before Cargo or Homebrew publication.

Declared project-root Cargo lib.rs/main.rs targets are bounded exact-file scan selections, not recursive scans of the project root. Literal resolved workspace members preserve whole-member boundaries and exact cross-member target ownership. Checked validator reads preserve no-follow file identity, confinement, filters and existing input budgets. Explicit directory selections retain their stated scope; workspace glob expansion is not added. Configuration and release documentation require a 6.1.1 reader for exact-file selections because 6.1.0 skips them even when its reduced coverage reports 100%.

answers.constraints: Preserve explicit mappings, existing spec owners, exact target precedence and retained-root confinement. Qualification must identify one immutable SHA on Ubuntu and macOS; do not publish Cargo or Homebrew before qualification.
